# Hermes MkII-CLASS MAIL SHUTTLE
[color=#a4885c]Ship Size:[/color] Small
[color=#a4885c]Recommended Crew:[/color] 1
[color=#a4885c]Power Gen Type:[/color] Uranium x2
# Shuttle Brief
Introduced by The Pantheon Collective, the original Hermes was a well-respected choice for mail carriers in- and outside of Zekke. However, the circumstances of living within Zekke demanded changes and adaptations. Engineers of the sector came together to update and upgrade the speedy shuttle to better suit the needs of Dusk's carriers.
# Notable features and changes
- Redesigned interior and exterior of the ship, with fully patched and sealed holes hidden inside the shuttle's walls. - Proper living space within the former armored bow of the shuttle. - Expanded and better-organized servicing area. - Renewed wiring and piping layouts. - A new, less obstructing containment box for the plush.
- Hermes MkII's cockpit is equipped with a Parking Mode switch that controls the ship's large thrusters, to help with precise maneuvering.
# Technical Details
In standard configuration, Hermes MkII's power load is 36.5 kW. This can be reduced to 4.7 kW by disengaging the navigation systems with the master switch located in engineering.
The ship is devided into two sections for the purposes of APC destribution: Bow (powers the cockpit and the living area) and Stern (powers engineering and the servicing area).
MkII is equipped with 9 thrusters: 4 rear-facing (2 of those are large thrusters), 3 forward-facing and 2 side-facing (1 for each side).
